Implement only this approved receipt-punctuality pilot. For each Vendor, use Purch. Rcpt. Line records with matching Buy-from Vendor No., Type Item, Quantity>0, nonblank Promised Receipt Date, and Posting Date in the inclusive WorkDate-89 through WorkDate window. Each eligible posted line counts once, regardless of quantity or partial receipts. Count a line as on time when Posting Date is on/before its recorded Promised Receipt Date. Show eligible count and Receipt Punctuality % = 100 * on-time count / eligible count, rounded to one decimal place. With zero eligible lines show No data and no percentage. Add read-only displays in a Receipt Punctuality group after General on Vendor Card and columns after Name on Vendor List. Refresh per vendor and on page refresh. This uses posting dates as the agreed proxy for receipt timing; do not claim order completeness, historical original promises, customer impacts, notifications, or an overall reliability score.
